notes: IMDog is the ERC-20 token in src/IMDog.sol. Its no-argument constructor mints the entire fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 IMDOG with 18 decimals once to msg.sender. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. The token exposes no administrative powers, additional minting, or transfer fees. The pool uses the specified paired token, a 0.3% fee, and tick spacing 60. initialPrice is a provenance-only sqrtPriceX96 reference computed from initialMarketCapWei / totalSupply with IMDog as currency0; the deployer derives the actual opening price from the economics and supply using the deployed currency ordering.
